entries.english: Various complaints by Albrecht von Rosenberg zu Boxberg to Archbishop Daniel of Mainz: (1) concerning the jurisdictional rights of the lordship at Schüpf; (2) concerning the Rosenberg hereditary fiefs, namely half of Uiffingen village, which Michael von Rosenberg had sold to the Rüdt von Collenberg family; (3) concerning the proposed exchange of the benefice at Uissigheim (‘Ussumstadt’) for those at Buchen; (4) concerning Sebastian and Contz Rüdt von Collenberg of Bödigheim's interference with grazing rights; and (5) concerning Sebastian Rüdt von Collenberg's sole claim to guardianship of Veltin Rüdt's children. (6 leaves).
